evidence.detail: nav li:hover > .item + .submenu { display: block } — submenu appears instantly with no transition
nav, .menu, .submenu { display: none } — toggling display:none/block cannot be transitioned directly with CSS transition
No transition rules exist on .submenu or the menu-level selectors; transitions only appear on language-menu (line 2950) and a-links (176)

triage.fix_sketch: In shared_web/static/css/pd.css: replace the display:none/block toggle for .submenu with an opacity+visibility approach — set .submenu { visibility:hidden; opacity:0; transition: opacity 0.2s ease, visibility 0.2s } and on the hover rule set visibility:visible; opacity:1. This sidesteps the 'border disappearing during ease' issue the author noted (which was likely caused by transitioning width or display). Changes confined to pd.css, ~10-15 lines.
triage.notes: The issue author noted the transition was removed due to a border disappearing during ease, so the fix should use opacity/visibility rather than any width or display transition. Testing with the border-right on .submenu (pd.css:821) is important.
